specs.authoredModuleSummary: Pieces-harness is a test harness module providing utilities to open, load, and inspect rendered pieces for use by validation check scripts like check-islands and check-pieces.
specs.description: `pieces-harness.mjs` — Pieces-harness. Called from `«check-islands».ts (top level)` and `«check-pieces».ts (top level)`, and possibly from places the call graph cannot see. `openPieces` builds `load`, `openPieces` builds `text`, `createHarness` builds `get`, `createHarness` builds `id`, `createHarness` builds `mark`, `createHarness` builds `fill`, `createHarness` builds `slot` and `createHarness` builds `island`, and no requirement here is about what runs inside them. No requirements recorded yet — 2 operations were examined and no obligation was decided about them.
